youtube.title: Where was the first Formula 1 race? A bomber base and a king 🏁
youtube.description:
Monza, Monaco or the third one? The World Championship opened in May on a circuit laid out over the runways of a wartime bomber airfield, with a reigning king in the grandstand. The season had just seven rounds; this year's has 24.
Guess before the map lights up, then see the airfield, the first champion and the road to the finale.
Which did you pick?
